title: Qubit Coupled Cluster Method: A Systematic Approach to Quantum Chemistry on a Quantum Computer
venue: Journal of Chemical Theory and Computation
problem_summary: Introduces the Qubit Coupled Cluster (QCC) method: an ansatz constructed directly in qubit space (rather than lifted from a fermionic coupled-cluster expansion) via a systematic, energy-gradient-screened selection of Pauli-word entangling generators.

components.family_or_name: Qubit Coupled Cluster (QCC): qubit-space ansatz built from screened Pauli-word generators
components.notes: Constructed directly in qubit space rather than by mapping a fermionic UCC expansion.

components.family_or_name: energy-gradient screening of candidate Pauli-word generators

workflow_composition_notes: Generators are screened and selected by gradient magnitude directly in qubit space, then variationally optimized -- methodologically a precursor in spirit to the later ADAPT-VQE family (grimsley2019 et seq.), though qubit-space-native rather than fermionic-operator-based from the start.
